Messages.Body:
Enticement, Action, Serpentis, C2 , [FN:C2]
Only usable if you control the Edge. [ser] (D) Burn the Edge to cause
your prey to burn 2 pool. (This action is directed at your prey.) Your
minions cannot attempt bleed actions for the remainder of the turn.
[SER] As above, but your prey burns 3 pool.

Does the restriction refer to the minions you *currently* have?
If I get another minion after having played enticement, lets say with
sould gem, can that minion bleed then? It wasnt "targeted" by this
restriction.

Some other cards with similar effects where I dont know the rules for
all of them:

Annabelle Triabell, 9, dom for AUS CEL PRE, Toreador, 3, [CE:V]
Camarilla Primogen: Annabelle can give all Toreador +1 bleed for the
remainder of the turn as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood. If
that action is successful, annabelle untaps.
(doesnt affect minions entering play afterwards afaik)

Tajdid, Master, Assamite, R2 , [FN:R2]
Master. For the remainder of the game, the Blood Curse no longer
prevents Assamites from committing diablerie. Only one Tajdid can be
played in a game.
(dont know about this)

Psychic Veil, Action, 1 blood, Obfuscate, R , [Jyhad:R, V:TES:R,
CE:R/PM]
[obf] All of your vampires` actions are at +1 stealth this turn. [OBF]
All of your minions` actions are at +1 stealth this turn.
(doesnt affect minions entering play afterwards afaik)

duration that you control them.

> all of them:

> remainder of the turn as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood. If
> that action is successful, annabelle untaps.
> (doesnt affect minions entering play afterwards afaik)
>

Affects all Toreador, even those that were not in play or were not
Toreador.

those minions.

> Psychic Veil, Action, 1 blood, Obfuscate, R , [Jyhad:R, V:TES:R,
> CE:R/PM]
> [obf] All of your vampires` actions are at +1 stealth this turn. [OBF]

It does. No previous ruling on that card specifically, AFAIK.

Red Herring's restriction would be handled similarly.
Similarly, Psychic Projection would give a subsequently-influenced
vampire +1 intercept.
See also Protected Resources (burned if a minion you later bring out
bleeds).
